notes.title: Planes, Trains And Automobiles! You Deserve A New Demo Version!
notes.notes:
Hello drivers!

We just released the v0.0.8 update for Pest Apocalypse and the demo!

It's a more polished experience overall, with an improved skill tree and improvements to the bouncy vehicle physics! We also have a bunch of new enemies type for you to smash, crash, shoot and slaughter on your way to deliver pizza to the hungry survivors of the Pest Apocalypse!

We still have a lot of work ahead of us, but we hope you enjoy what we have for you so far!
Don't forget to wishlist and tell your friends about your favorite post apocalyptic pizza delivery game!

Have fun, drive crazy, we love you ♥

Kikimora Crew

P.S. Join our Discord and tell us what you think about the game! We want to improve it as much as possible and that can only happen with your help!

notes.title: New Demo Version & Games From Croatia
notes.notes:
Hello drivers!

We just released the v0.0.6 update for Pest Apocalypse and the demo!

It includes a massive amount of early game changes, a whole new map to help you learn the basics of the game, additional gameplay settings to help tweak your experience, and a whole truckload of graphical updates to improve your pixel-to-eyeball experience!

We still have a lot of work ahead of us, but we hope you enjoy what we have for you so far!
Don't forget to wishlist and tell your friends about your favorite post apocalyptic pizza delivery game!

We are also super excited to announce that we are joining the Games From Croatia festival! Some of you may be wondering "How Kikimora Games? Aren't you a Swedish game studio?" And you are correct, but also have a Croatian co-founder, and he is very proud to have Pest Apocalypse stand back-to-back with some of the coolest new games coming out of Croatia! So make sure to checkout the festivals Steam page for awesome games from your favorite Cro-bros!

Have fun, drive crazy, we love you ♥

Kikimora Crew
